# R22 event study, holdout sessions (generated by r22study.py, source release)

Sessions: BANKNIFTY 122 (2025-08-25 - 2026-02-23, median ATR14 497, median W 0.51); NIFTY 120 (2025-10-13 - 2026-04-13, median ATR14 216, median W 0.46); FINNIFTY 92 (2025-10-13 - 2026-02-24, median ATR14 259, median W 0.50).

Width terciles (W = range / ATR14, design, pooled): narrow < 0.407 <= normal < 0.563 <= wide.

Columns: mv15/30/60/c = move after the decision over 15/30/60 min / to 15:29 in the event's direction (ATR14); ex30/exc = minus the same-minute baseline; t_exc = t of exc (events treated as independent: descriptive); mfe60/mae60 = best / worst in 60 min (ATR); win_c = share further on at 15:29; mv30 / mvc in index points. Directions: REJECT / FAIL / RETEST-FAIL = back into the range (or away from the mid / inner level); BREAK / HOLD / RETEST-HOLD = the break's way. twin rnd = levels mirrored around the 10:00 price.
